reason: Phuong phap sinh thiet kinh dien bang kim Menghini qua da hoac cau hoi ve thu thuat xam lan trong chan doan gan.
Ung thu bieu mo te bao gan (HCC) la loai ung thu gan nguyen phat pho bien nhat (chiem >80-90%).
Trong benh canh ton thuong gan co bat thuong AFP hoac tren nen viem gan B/C, HCC luon la chan doan hang dau.
Hoa dau tac mach (TACE) ket hop PEI hoac RFA cho u nho < 3cm khong phau thuat duoc.
Phac do PLADO (Cisplatin + Doxorubicin/Platinol + Doxorubicin) la phac do kinh dien dac trung nhat cho ung thu nguyen bao gan (Hepatoblastoma).
Sinh thiet kim Menghini duoi huong dan cua sieu am la ky thuat tieu chuan de lay mau ton thuong khu tru o gan.
TACE (nut dong mach gan hoa dau) la phuong phap dieu tri pho bien nhat cho HCC da o hoac khong con chi dinh cat gan.
Phan chia giai doan I va II sau mo (nhu cua SIOPEL/COG trong hepatoblastoma): Giai doan I cat tron ven dien cat am tinh (sach), giai doan II dien cat con te bao vi the.
The tich con tuyet doi PEI moi lan tiem hoac luong hoa chat/Lipiodol bom trong TACE thuong trong khoang 8-10 ml (hoac 10-20ml).
RFA cho u don doc hoac <= 3 khoi <= 3 cm la chi dinh tieu chuan vang trong huong dan dieu tri pha huy u tai cho.
U mau gan lanh tinh the hang (cavernous hemangioma) la u lanh tinh pho bien nhat o gan can chan doan phan biet.
Phau thuat cat phan thuy gan triet can la phuong phap dieu tri triet de uu tien hang dau khi chuc nang gan con tot.
Tieu chuan chan doan AFP kinh dien: AFP > 400 ng/ml duong tinh ket hop hinh anh hoc hoac AFP > 3.500 ng/ml rat dac trung.
Phau thuat cat phan thuy gan triet can khi u khu tru phan thuy.
Chup cat lop vi tinh (CT scanner) co tieng thuoc can quang 3 pha dong/tinh mach la phuong tien chan doan xac dinh chu luc cua HCC.
Ung thu bieu mo te bao gan (HCC) la trong tam chu yeu cua bai hoc.
Phan do giai doan TNM (T3a N0 M0 thuong la IIIA trong ung thu gan theo AJCC 7/8).
Chi tieu Vicryl (nhu Vicryl 0 hoac 2-0) la loai chi tieu thuong duoc dung de khau cam mau dien cat gan.
Giai doan IVA (xam lan hoac hach vung N1) hoac IVB (di can xa M1).
TACE la lua chon pho bien cho cac khoi u trung gian hoac khong cat duoc.
Phac do PLADO la dac hieu cho ung thu nguyen bao gan (hepatoblastoma).
Hoa tac mach khoi u (TACE) qua dong mach gan cho cac ton thuong gan da o.
Hoa dau nut mach qua catheter TACE la bien phap can thiep mach chu luc.
Chien luoc dieu tri tieu chuan cua hepatoblastoma: Hoa tri tien phau 2-4 dot -> phau thuat cat u -> hoa tri bo tro du 6 dot.
5 chi so tinh diem Child-Pugh: Bilirubin, Albumin, Ty le Prothrombin (hoac INR), Co truong, Hoi chung nao gan.
Hai cong thuc chan doan HCC cua Bo Y te/APASL: Cong thuc 1 gom AFP (thuong >200 hoac >400 ng/ml) + hinh anh dien hinh; Cong thuc 2 co sinh thiet mo benh hoc.
Phac do hoa tri phoi hop chuan PLADO trong ung thu nguyen bao gan.
Phan loai diem Child-Pugh chuan y khoa: Child A: 5-6 diem, Child B: 7-9 diem, Child C: 10-15 diem.
Phan giai doan sau mo cua Hepatoblastoma theo SIOPEL hoac COG.
HCC la ung thu gan pho bien nhat o nguoi lon.
Giai doan I theo he thong xep hang giai doan lam sang/sau mo.
Phan biet u nguoi lon (HCC) va u tre em (Hepatoblastoma).
Theo phan loai AJCC, N1 thuoc ve giai doan IVA (T bat ky N1 M0).
Sinh thiet kim Menghini duoi sieu am la phuong phap xam lan lay mau mo tieu chuan.
Bai tap tinh diem Child-Pugh thuong roi vao Child-Pugh B (7 hoac 8 diem).
Ung thu bieu mo te bao gan la chu de trung tam.
Phau thuat cat phan thuy gan triet can cho khoi u khu tru.
Sau mo cat u hepatoblastoma, buoc tiep theo la hoa tri bo tro sau mo cho du 6 dot.
Phan loai T trong HCC: T3a (nhieu u > 5cm), T3b (xam lan nhanh lon tinh mach cua hoac tinh mach gan).
Child-Pugh C thuong la 11 hoac 12 diem trong tinh huong lam sang nang.
RFA (dot song cao tan) la ky thuat huy khoi u tai cho duoc chuong nhat hien nay.
T3a (u lon/nhieu o) va T3b (xam lan nhanh tinh mach cua).
Nghiem phap kep Pringle ngat quang la ky thuat kiem soat chay mau cuong gan kinh dien nhat trong phau thuat cat gan.
Dac diem dich te hoc ung thu nguyen bao gan: Hay gap o tre em (95% duoi 4 tuoi) va khong lien quan den HBV (khac voi HCC lien quan chat che voi HBV).
